svg.title: The remaining assembly changes only auxiliary tower rows. Suppose a transition has metric factors Hf, Hc with the stated analytic and positive lower bounds, response rows A0, T with their carried fine-difference bounds, and inverse defect dT 2 Cd2, where C is analytic and positive on im d2. Extend C to a uniformly positive full three-form row without changing dT 2 Cd2, take its analytic square root
